clues.text: Jacob's twin was given this second name after begging for some of the red stew Jacob was cooking.
During the wilderness journey, this nation refused to let Israel pass through its territory, so Israel turned away.
At Mount Hor, near the border of this land, the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
King David placed garrisons all through this land, and all its people became subject to him.
Obadiah told this nation, living in the clefts of the rocks, that the pride of its heart had deceived it.
When Jerusalem fell, the sons of this nation shouted to tear the city down to its foundations.
King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, near Eloth in this land, on the Red Sea shore.
